tex_content.html: 1. I.5With $\tau =-t$ and the measure constraint in (39), \begin{align} {d\over d\tau }\left(\tau \int _M(f-n/2)dm\right)& ={\mathcal W}(g(t),f(t),\tau ), \end{align} and under (41) the same identity holds with $(4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}e^{-f}dV$. Likewise, under (13), \begin{equation} {d\over dt}\left(-\int _Mfe^{-f}dV\right)={\mathcal F}(g(t),f(t)). \end{equation}
